chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Fazalah ibn Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Ibn Abi Ya'fur! Indeed God is One, unified in His Oneness, unique in His Command. So He created creatures and destined them for that Command. So we are they, O Ibn Abi Ya'fur! We are the Divine Proofs of God among His servants, His treasurers over His Knowledge, and the custodians of that.'

key_terms.حُجَجُ اللَّهِ: Divine Proofs/Authorities of God — the Imams as God's arguments and evidence on earth, a key Shia theological concept
key_terms.خُزَّانُهُ عَلَى عِلْمِهِ: His treasurers over His Knowledge — the Imams as exclusive repositories of divine knowledge
key_terms.وَاحِدٌ مُتَوَحِّدٌ بِالْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ: One, unified in His Oneness — three reinforcing expressions of divine singularity emphasizing absolute unity without partner or comparison

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the Imams being the Divine Proofs of God?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) addresses his trusted companion Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur with a foundational creedal statement about divine unity and Imamate. The Imam declares that God's absolute Oneness (tawhid) necessitated the creation of a special class of beings destined to carry His command — and identifies the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt as those very beings. This hadith was addressed to Ibn Abi Ya'fur, one of the Imam's most intimate companions, affirming the Imams' exclusive roles as Divine Proofs (hujaj), guardians of God's knowledge, and custodians of His authority.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Abdullah Bin Abu Yafour who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O ibn Abu Yafour! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is One, Unified with the Oneness, Unique with His<sup>azwj</sup> Command. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the creatures and He<sup>azwj</sup> Determined them for that Command. So we<sup>asws</sup> are they<sup>asws</sup>, O Ibn Abu Yafour! So we<sup>asws</sup> are the Divine Authorities of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> among His<sup>azwj</sup> servant, and His<sup>azwj</sup> treasurers upon His<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge, and the custodians of that’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Fudala ibn Ayyub from ‘Abdallh ibn ya‘fur who has said that Imam abu ‘Abdallh (a.s.) said him the following.

“O ibn abu ya‘fur, Allah is One and is the only One in His Oneness. He alone issues His command. He created a creature and appointed and measured them for that command (Amr, task). We are, O ibn abu ya‘fur are that creature. We are the authority of Allah over His creatures, the treasurers of His knowledge and the guardians of it.”
